# Terminal

Terminal emulates a classic terminal with a green-on-black interface styled in Fira Code and terminal-like prompts. Its recorded features include a fancy cursor, an active-line prompt, an airline status bar, find and replace behaviour, peek previews, a minimal UI and ASCII decorations.

![Terminal screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zcysxy/Obsidian-Terminal-Theme/HEAD/screenshots/terminal.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Terminal"
    author: "zcysxy"
    repo:   "zcysxy/Obsidian-Terminal-Theme"
    slug:   "terminal"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/terminal"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/zcysxy/Obsidian-Terminal-Theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zcysxy/Obsidian-Terminal-Theme/HEAD/screenshots/terminal.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Emulate a classic terminal in Obsidian with a green-on-black, Fira Code-styled interface and terminal-like prompts. Apply terminal features like a fancy cursor, active-line prompt, airline status bar, find/replace behavior, peek previews, minimal UI, and ASCII decorations."
}
```
